title: The items on the shelf
description: What GET /api/v1/shelf answers and `ingestion shelf list --json` prints: each item that a person sorted by a shelf verb, personal-relate, personal-summarize or technical-summarize, whose newest decisions still hold it there, the oldest landed first. Nothing runs on a shelved item until a person opens it with POST /api/v1/shelf/{key}/open.

verb.description: The shelf verb that the person sorted the item by.

lens.description: The lens through which opening a summary reads the item, and null for a relate, which runs on the person's machine and keeps nothing in the service.

state.description: waiting until a person opens it. A relate then reads opened. A summary reads reading while its model read is queued or running, done once kept, and failed where it failed, which a retry of its task runs again.

sorted_ts.description: When it was sorted, as a store stamp.

opened_ts.description: When it was first opened, and null while it waits.

summary.description: A summary's model read once done, as prompts/model-read/answer.schema.json answers it, and null before. It is a model's over the item's text, so a reader treats it as outsider text.

error.description: Why the summary's model read failed, and null unless state is failed.
